1.

Once on the path of death I was, But the way of life I have found, And beyond the wilderness now I see The land which God gives to His own. Here I have not my home, A wilderness is to me this world, Here I have not my home.

2.

As a stranger only I wander here, My blessed home above is there. With Christ first I shall remain, Not this land has my love. Here I have not my home, A wilderness is to me this world, Here I have not my home.

3.

Praise be to God in heaven’s height, I shall share my Lord’s joy In Jerusalem in rest, The heavenly, where I may dwell! O there, there is my home, A wilderness is to me this world, Here I have not my home.
